title: ChatterBox
description: Give your chat a little makeover!
body:
![Chatter Box](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryderbelserion/ChatterBox/refs/heads/main/branding/header.png)

ChatterBox is the kitchen sink of chat formatting for Minecraft. You can customize the look of your chat, have integration with LuckPerms, custom join messages, and more to come!

### Installation
[Click Me](https://docs.ryderbelserion.com/minecraft/mods/chatterbox/#installation)

### Useful Links
[Frequently Asked Questions](https://docs.ryderbelserion.com/minecraft/mods/chatterbox/faq/)

All support for the mod is provided through our [Discord](https://discord.gg/ktxCyUd7Ny), If you have a question that is not answered by the wiki, Do not hestitate to ping me.

If you have any bug reports/feature requests, [Open an issue on GitHub.](https://github.com/ryderbelserion/ChatterBox/issues)
